# Pull request

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.vi.md)

## Summary
Describe the engineering change and why it is needed.

## Contract impact
- [ ] GPU ownership remains explicit, or the new mapping is documented.
- [ ] No model weights, credentials, runtime logs, or generated keys are added.
- [ ] Model-license/provenance impact is documented when applicable.
- [ ] EN/VI documentation counterparts are updated together.
- [ ] Public tunnel behavior remains fail-closed behind authentication.

## Evidence
List exact test commands, Kaggle evidence when applicable, and measured outputs. Do not claim real-model qualification from CPU CI alone.
